# Model Fitting Setup Validation

Make the estimand and fitted data explicit before comparing or accepting
models.

## Setup

Resolve the applicable choices:

- requested output: prediction, optimum location, response at the optimum,
  model metric, coefficient, p-value, class, or another quantity;
- response and predictor definitions, units, transformations, and category or
  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;
- candidate models, formulas, fixed parameters, and fitting implementation;
- comparison metric and convention

library(splines)
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
parse_p <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == '287') return(1)
  if (strain == '98') return(0)
  if (strain == '287_98') {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio, ':', fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}
d"'$p287 <- mapply(parse_p, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
curve <- d[!is.na(d$p287), ]
cat('"'n curve:', nrow(curve), '\\n')
print(curve[, c('DishNumber','StrainNumber','Ratio','Replicate','Area','p287')])
mods <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 2, raw=TRUE), data=curve),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 3, raw=TRUE), data=curve),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df=4), data=curve)
)
print(sapply(mods, AIC))
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  fit <- mods[[nm]]
  f <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p287=x)))
  opt <- optimize(function(x) -f(x), interval=c(0,1))
  grid <- seq(0,1,length.out=10001)
  pgrid <- predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p287=grid))
  imax <- which.max(pgrid)
  cat(nm, 'opt_p=', format(opt"'$minimum, digits=17), '"'opt_pred=', format(-opt"'$objective, digits=17), '"'grid_p=', grid[imax], 'grid_pred=', max(pgrid), '\\n')
}
best <- mods[[which.min(sapply(mods, AIC))]]
opt <- optimize(function(x) -as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(p287=x))), interval=c(0,1))
cat('BEST', names(mods)[which.min(sapply(mods, AIC))], '\\n')
cat(format(-opt"'$objective, digits=17), '"'\\n')
# Interior-only sensitivity
mix <- d[d"'$StrainNumber == '"'287_98', ]
parts <- strsplit(mix"'$Ratio, '"':', fixed=TRUE)
mix"'$p287 <- vapply(parts, function(z) { z <- as.numeric(z); z[1]/sum(z)}, numeric(1))
mods2 <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 2, raw=TRUE), data=mix),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 3, raw=TRUE), data=mix),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df=4), data=mix)
)
cat('"'interior-only n:', nrow(mix),'\\n')
print(sapply(mods2, AIC))
for (nm in names(mods2)) {
  fit <- mods2[[nm]]
  rng <- range(mix"'$p287)
  opt2 <- optimize(function(x) -as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p287=x))), interval=rng)
  cat('"'interior', nm, 'range=', paste(rng,collapse=':'), 'opt_p=', format(opt2"'$minimum, digits=17), '"'opt_pred=', format(-opt2"'$objective, digits=17), '"'\\n')
}
RS"

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
library(splines)
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
parse_p287 <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == '287') return(1)
  if (strain == '98') return(0)
  if (strain == '287_98') {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio, ':', fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  NA_real_
}
d"'$p287 <- mapply(parse_p287, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
curve <- d[!is.na(d$p287), ]
models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 2, raw=TRUE), data=curve),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ poly(p287, 3, raw=TRUE), data=curve),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df=4), data=curve)
)
best_name <- names(which.min(sapply(models, AIC)))
best <- models[[best_name]]
# For the natural spline, optimize over all basis knot intervals plus boundaries.
basis <- ns(curve$p287, df=4)
breaks <- sort(unique(c(attr(basis, '"'Boundary.knots'), attr(basis, 'knots'))))
pred <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(p287=x)))
cands <- data.frame(p=breaks, y=vapply(breaks, pred, numeric(1)))
for (i in seq_len(length(breaks) - 1L)) {
  lo <- breaks[i]; hi <- breaks[i + 1L]
  opt <- optimize(function(x) -pred(x), interval=c(lo, hi))
  cands <- rbind(cands, data.frame(p=opt"'$minimum, y=-opt$objective))
}
ans <- max(cands$y)
dir.create('"'codex_output', showWarnings=FALSE)
writeLines(format(ans, digits=17), 'codex_output/answer.txt')
cat('best_model=', best_name, '\\n', sep='')
cat('AICs\\n')
print(sapply(models, AIC))
cat('knots=', paste(format(breaks, digits=17), collapse=', '), '\\n', sep='')
cat('max_p=', format(cands"'$p[which.max(cands$y)], digits=17), '"'\\n', sep='')
cat('max_pred=', format(ans, digits=17), '\\n', sep='')
RS
printf 'answer.txt: '; cat codex_output/answer.txt; printf '\\n'"
